name: ModelVariant129_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant129_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (up to sixteen points follow the slot's parts, then each draws a growing, fading fan of triangles and a shell of dots while the slot is tinted and the camera moves between the slots); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request modulo 100, seeds the dot shell and packs two texture images, tinting the slot when the request is 100 or more, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 4 as each point starts, 1 when the last one does, 2 once the last fan ends and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; only the USA and Japanese discs build this header. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
